mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising PAYEMS (indicating labor market strength) and low UNRATE (below 4%) creates a 'goldilocks' zone, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of 'goldilocks' zone instances, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in INDPRO, signaling reduced industrial production, precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to anticipated supply chain disruptions.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of quarters with declining INDPRO, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS growth exceeding 5% month-over-month, indicating strong residential investment, supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 45% of instances with RSAFS MoM growth > 5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of low FEDFUNDS (below 1%) and rising CPIAUCSL (above 240) creates an inflationary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of inflationary environment instances, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE (below 3.5%) without corresponding PAYEMS growth indicates labor market inefficiencies, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 50% of labor market inefficiency instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST growth exceeding 10% year-over-year, signaling strong housing demand, supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during non-recessionary periods.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of non-recessionary instances with HOUST YoY growth > 10%, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 5-year rolling window.
